answer: Since the throttle counters live in the quartz ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 207 keys therefore pays for 207 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the jetty quota and the jade admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 2 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole swarm at once. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
